business_problem: Mercari needed to reduce the effort and guesswork sellers face when creating listings, because poor descriptions, missing attributes, and post-sale friction limited conversion and slowed marketplace growth.
solution_summary: Mercari embedded OpenAI models into two listing workflows so sellers can create better marketplace content with less manual effort. The first feature, Mercari AI Assistant, combines offline GPT-4 analysis of top-performing category listings with online GPT-3.5 Turbo evaluation of live user listings to identify missing attributes and suggest improvements when items remain unsold. The second feature, AI Listing Support, takes uploaded product photos, uses GPT-4o mini to suggest categories, and then generates tailored titles and descriptions for each item. Mercari originally built that flow with GPT-4 and later moved it to GPT-4o mini for lower latency, better cost efficiency, and multi-image support, then continued refining outputs by comparing AI-generated descriptions to actual listings after launch. This architecture keeps AI inside the existing seller journey so the assistance feels native rather than like a separate tool.

data_flow: Seller photos and listing drafts enter Mercari's listing flows, where GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 Turbo power evaluation and optimization for existing listings, while GPT-4o mini classifies new photo-based listings and generates final titles and descriptions that are compared against real marketplace outcomes for ongoing refinement.
business_outcome: Mercari improved listing quality, increased conversion, saved sellers time, and created a scalable AI layer that now supports hundreds of AI-assisted listings per minute across its marketplace.
